messages:
Maria Chen: Quick heads-up — aiming to roll v2.4.3 to prod tomorrow (Wed) at 16:00 UTC. Need smoke ownership, rollback readiness, and a short CS/marketing handoff. Who can own the smoke window? :wave:
Sam Patel: I can own smoke and monitoring. Plan: canary at 15:50 UTC -> full flip at 16:00 -> verification window 16:00-16:10. I’ll run the smoke script and watch latency/error rates. :white_check_mark:
Maria Chen: awesome. Sam, can you add the smoke checklist to the release PR and drop a link here?
Sam Patel: will do. Checklist preview: `./scripts/smoke.sh --env=prod --checks=kpis,ingress,kvcache` then `kubectl rollout status deploy/redwood-inference --namespace=prod`. I’ll post the exact commands in the PR.
Liz Ortega: Support on standby for the 16:00 window. I’ll prep a short quick-response doc (troubleshooting + customer-facing lines) and watch #support-alerts. Please ping me immediately on any spike. :telephone_receiver:
Jordan Kim: Marketing — we’ll prepare a short in-product banner and a customer email draft. We prefer waiting 30 minutes post-flip to confirm stability before sending anything broad. Can someone upload the release notes draft to the doc?
Maria Chen: I’ll open the release notes PR in ~30m and tag you, Jordan. For now: highlight API changes, rate-limit note, and improved caching perf.
Alex Rivera: Feature-flag and rollback notes: make sure feature flag `experiment/v2-redispatch` is set to off-by-default. Rollback plan: 1) flip flag off, 2) restart replicas with `kubectl rollout undo`, 3) revert routing to previous model variant. Commands I’ll paste in the PR runbook.
Sam Patel: I’ll validate the rollback commands in staging tonight and confirm. Also will attach dashboards and the SLO watchlist link.
Deploy Bot: automatic deploy window reserved for 2026-05-20 16:00 UTC. If you need to cancel, react with :x: to this thread.
Support Bot: Standby checklist created: https://confluence.redwood/support/runbooks/v2-deploy-checklist (internal)
Liz Ortega: +1 to waiting 30m before customer comms. I’ll create a short incident-template in case we need to escalate.
Maria Chen: small ask for cross-team alignment: when Sam posts the smoke checklist and Alex posts rollback commands, please each add a one-line acceptance (e.g., "I confirm I can run this at 15:50 UTC"). That helps audit and handoff.
Jordan Kim: once PR is up, I’ll add the marketing copy bullet points. If we’re green at +30, we send out the email and update release notes.
Sam Patel: checklist posted in PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/release-prs/pull/523 — I confirm I can run at 15:50 UTC.
Alex Rivera: rollback commands added to PR runbook and validated in staging. I confirm rollback readiness.
Maria Chen: perfect. Final run-through tomorrow morning at 09:30 UTC in this thread for any last-minute blockers. Thanks everyone :rocket:
